basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old fitness enthusiast and aspiring nutritionist based in Portland, Oregon. I have a keen interest in intermittent fasting and its health benefits. I work as a part-time personal trainer and spend my free time hiking in the Pacific Northwest. I’m single, and my online hours vary, but I’m typically active in the evenings after work. I'm passionate about maintaining a healthy lifestyle and enjoy sharing tips and experiences with others.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in kinesiology, having completed a bachelor's degree in exercise science. I'm currently self-teaching about nutrition and weight management through online courses and books. My interest in intermittent fasting began about a year ago, and I've been experimenting with various fasting protocols to understand their effects better.
